items.title: John Handy Interview, 1958-12-04
items.q: Yeah, man. But you see that was Lewis' band before he left New Orleans. ... Oh, Lewis Russell.

ctx.x: What are these different guys specialize in?

Oh, they all practice players just like, except Buddy Petit. He had his own style of playing. That's where Lewis got a lot of his artists from Buddy Petit. He got a lot of artists from Buddy Petit, Chris Kelly. This fellow, Dude Foster. He never played nothing hard. He never went out of the staff. Everything he played was right down on the staff. But he was a wonderful man. He was a wonderful man. When he stood in his sober. He drank too, huh? Oh yeah. And then he used to take three and four jobs for one night.…

Say I wanted to show you this picture. That's what I've been looking for. Here's Earl Hines. Here's his sack section here. What is it? Uh... My glass. I was wondering if this was the guy. Any of these guys. That looks like Omar Simeon to me there. I don't know who that is. It's peach me.
